integrity: The recurrence and multiset rooted-tree enumeration are provided with a standalone exact-integer checker, direct subset checks, and observed output. The minimality/uniqueness classification is separate from the previously known explicit windmill polynomial formula.
scientific_limitations: Order-at-most-16 cutoff is a finite computer-assisted exhaustive proof; it does not settle domination-polynomial unimodality for all graphs. Existing 2025 results already give the polynomial identity. Full bibliographic priority and independent mathematical audit are not established.
title: The unique first failure of domination-polynomial log-concavity in trivially perfect graphs
